ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
summary: Financial assistance to Scheduled Caste students studying at the post-matriculation or post-secondary stage.
benefits: Reimbursement of tuition/other fees plus a maintenance allowance, based on course and residence status.
eligibility: Student belongs to a Scheduled Caste
Family income within the prescribed limit
Enrolled in a recognized post-matric institution
application_steps: Register and apply on the National Scholarship Portal
Institution verifies and forwards the application
